# YouTube agent skill components

This directory contains the unmodified hook scorer, hook formula data, and title linter from
[`Jakeschincariol/youtube-agent-skill`](https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/youtube-agent-skill),
used under its MIT license. Amala uses them to rank candidate hooks and titles generated by Groq.
The upstream Claude skills are not executed and no Claude or paid API is required.

Upstream snapshot reviewed: 2026-10-25.
